exposure: timing of GDM screening (24-28 weeks vs. 32-34 weeks)
outcome: detection rate of GDM at 32-34 weeks
admission to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
cohort: The study included 300 antenatal mothers selected serially from an antenatal OutPatient Department.
finding: The study found a GDM incidence rate of 8.7% at 24-28 weeks, with an additional 2.9% detected upon re-screening at 32-34 weeks among initially screen-negative women, and GDM was associated with increased risks of maternal and perinatal complications.
mod_finding: The rate of caesarean section was significantly higher among GDM mothers (76.5%) compared to non-GDM mothers.
birth_weight: Average birth weight for babies of GDM mothers was 2.53 kg and for non-GDM mothers was 2.73 kg.
gest_age: GDM screening was performed at 24-28 weeks and 32-34 weeks of gestation; preterm delivery was a measured outcome.
